definition: Static trace replay with one merged 109-offset Teacher whose training, score update, issue gate, and phase boundary are unchanged. Each phase exports the top positive-score winner in each historical offset family. Student candidates use strict or minimum-reserved family partitions, degree=2, a 2% extra marginal threshold, independent-top1 or exact cross-family max-union selection, and the shared F256 P8/E4 3:1 local resource model.
